description: This is a Python source file defining a class 'ImportModelsCommand' for importing models in the Superset project. It includes methods for validation, importing, and handling configuration data, with references to external modules like marshmallow, SQLAlchemy, and Superset-specific utilities.

classes.name: ImportModelsCommand
classes.description: A command class for importing models into the Superset system, handling validation, configuration loading, and import execution with support for overwriting existing models.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with contents, optional passwords, SSH tunnel credentials, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: _import
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for performing the import process.

methods.name: _get_uuids
methods.description: Retrieves UUIDs of existing models from the database.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the import process within a transaction, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the contents, loads metadata and configs, and checks for conflicts or errors.

methods.name: _prevent_overwrite_existing_model
methods.description: Checks if existing models should be overwritten; adds validation errors if not allowed.
